title: nmrForge: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: nmrForge automates Bruker multidimensional NMR processing with NMRPipe and SMILE, records parameters and quality-control decisions, and provides spectrum viewing and peak localization. Version 1.0.5 is a patch release packaging existing phase/NUS fixes and evidence organization. The API version is 1.1.1; API parameters and the 38-column peak-table contract are unchanged. The 1.0.5 release provides the source and one Linux AppImage; see https://github.com/RociferX/nmrforge/releases for artifact availability and validation status. Version 1.0.2 is retained as a historical release. Dated real-data evidence and historical measurements are not new real-engine validation of this release.
